Punjab Congress Chief Offers Support Amidst Internal Dispute

Punjab Congress President Amarinder Singh Raja Warring stated he would perform any task, even carrying shoes, to support the party, amidst a reported dispute with Chief Minister Charanjit Singh Channi. Channi, in turn, appeared to soften his stance towards the Congress high command, acknowledging Rahul Gandhi as his leader. These developments suggest internal party dynamics and leadership negotiations within the Punjab Congress.
